RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, December 10, 2010/Agrahayana 19, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Agriculture;  Chemicals  and  Fertilizers;  Communications and
Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Earth Sciences; Human Resource Development; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Science and Technology; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
139
Railway projects running behind
schedule in U.P.
*441. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of railway projects which
are running behind schedule in Uttar
Pradesh under North Eastern Railway;
(b) the reasons for the same;
(c) the extent of cost and time overruns
as a result thereof;
(d) the responsibility fixed in the matter;
and
(e) the steps taken to avoid such a
situation in future?
Public investment in agriculture sector
*442. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: W ill the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether  it  is  a  fact  that  public
investment in agriculture has declined during
the last five years;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether Government has taken any
serious step to overcome the present crisis
in agriculture?
Suicide by farmers in Orissa
*443. SHRI RAMA CHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a poor farmer
of Dubakona village in Dashrathpur block
of Jajpur district, Orissa has committed
suicide for not being able to pay the loan
which he had taken for cultivation;
(b) if so, how many farmers in Orissa
have committed suicide till now and the
amount of compensation paid to the
bereaved  families  by  Government;
and

140
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) the preventive steps taken by
Government to check such unfortunate
incidents in future?
Bungling in railway procurement
†*444. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has been
informed by a railway officer of the
bungling of ` 10 thousand crores by
mechanical department every year in
railway procurement;
(b) if  so,  the  steps  taken  by
Government so far to ascertain the truth
thereof;
(c) the names of the officials bribed by
an American company to get the contract
of Brake Block in the year 2008 and the
action taken against them so far; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Payment to victims of train accident
†*445. SHRI    SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to refer to the
answer to Unstarred Question 574 given in
the Rajya Sabha on 12 November, 2010
and state:
(a) the total number of victims who have
been made ex-gratia  payment and the
number of those who are deprived of such
payment so far;
(b) the reasons for not making ex-gratia
payment to rest of the affected people and
by when this ex-gratia payment would be
made to them;
(c) the funds sanctioned in the years
2009-10 and 2010-11 for each additional
security gadget/system being installed for
checking accidents and the amount spent
till September, 2010; and
(d) the zones where security gadgets/
systems have been installed/are being
installed?
Prediction of cloud burst
*446. SHRIMA TI    VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of EARTH
SCIENCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether  Indian  Meteorological
Department (IMD) has been failing
in prediction of cloud bursts in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) the details of funds allocated and
spent on tracking the variability of weather
forecast systems in the country during
the last three years and the current year,
year-wise;
(d) whether the scientists are also sent
abroad to study weather forecast system
of the country;
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
amount spent by Government in this regard
during the aforesaid period; and
(f) the benefits accrued as a result
thereof?

141
Authorisation to export iron ore
*447. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of STEEL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
any request from Metal Scrap Trading
Corporation Ltd. (MSTC) seeking
authorization to export iron ore on the
pattern of export being done by Minerals
and Metals Trading Corporation (MMTC);
and
(b) if so, the details of the request
received from MSTC and the action taken
or proposed to be taken thereon?
Seats     for     weaker     and     socially
disadvantaged background children
under RTE Act
*448. SHRIMATI KANIMOZHI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether according to section 12 of
the Right to Education Act, all private
unaided schools must allocate 25 per cent
of the seats in Class I (or lowest grade) for
children from economically weaker and
socially disadvantaged backgrounds;
(b) whether Government has decided
upon the definition of economically weaker
and socially disadvantaged backgrounds;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether Government
